---
title: "Auto-merge"
description: "Merge strategies by update type, the available merge methods, and the branch protection GitHub requires before auto-merge can be enabled."
subtitle: "Letting qualifying updates merge without a human in the loop."
---

## How it works

With `auto-merge` enabled, the action turns on GitHub's auto-merge on the pull requests that match the configured strategy.
Those pull requests merge once the required status checks pass and the branch protection rules are satisfied.

::: {.callout-important}

Auto-merge requires at least one required status check or branch protection rule on the base branch.
Without one, GitHub refuses to enable auto-merge.

:::

## Strategies

`auto-merge-strategy` decides which updates qualify:

- `patch` (default) merges [patch]{.bump-patch} updates only, for example `1.0.0` to `1.0.1`.
- `minor` merges [minor]{.bump-minor} and [patch]{.bump-patch} updates, for example `1.0.0` to `1.1.0`.
- `all` merges every update, including [major]{.bump-major} versions.

## Methods

`auto-merge-method` decides how the merge is performed:

- `squash` (default) squashes the commits into one.
- `merge` creates a merge commit.
- `rebase` rebases and merges.

## Permissions

The workflow needs write access to pull requests:

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
```

## Examples

Auto-merge patch updates:

```yaml
name: Update Quarto Extensions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Quarto
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2
        with:
          version: "release"

      - uses: mcanouil/quarto-extensions-updater@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-merge: true
          auto-merge-strategy: "patch"
          auto-merge-method: "squash"
```

Auto-merge minor and patch updates:

```yaml
- uses: mcanouil/quarto-extensions-updater@v2
  with:
    github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    auto-merge: true
    auto-merge-strategy: "minor"
```

## Notes

- A pull request only merges once all required status checks pass.
- When auto-merge cannot be enabled, for example because of missing permissions or missing status checks, the pull request is still created without it.
- The action logs a warning in that case and carries on with the rest of the run.
- With [grouped updates](updates.qmd#grouped-updates), auto-merge is enabled only when every update in the group qualifies.
